description: This file appears to be a shell script responsible for monitoring, managing, and uploading logs in a device running RDK-based firmware. It contains functions for processing JSON responses, handling log files, waiting for system states (like time sync), uploading logs, and handling device reboot scenarios. It orchestrates log collection, compression, and upload tasks during system startup and operation.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines build type (DEV, VBN, PROD, CQA) from /version.txt.

methods.name: random_sleep
methods.description: Sleeps for a randomized period between 0 to 30 minutes to avoid synchronized uploads.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes a JSON response file, converting it into a key=value format in a configuration file.

methods.name: getLogfileSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of logs in a specified directory or file.

methods.name: getTFTPServer
methods.description: Retrieves TFTP server address based on build type.

methods.name: getLineSizeandRotate
methods.description: Checks log files for line count and rotates logs if exceeding size.

methods.name: reset_offset
methods.description: Resets log offsets in log sync files.

methods.name: get_logbackup_cfg
methods.description: Retrieves log backup configuration from syscfg or other system parameters.

methods.name: upload_nvram2_logs
methods.description: Uploads logs stored in nvram2 partitions.

methods.name: bootup_remove_old_backupfiles
methods.description: Removes old backup files during device boot.

methods.name: bootup_tarlogs
methods.description: Creates tar backups of log files on boot.

methods.name: bootup_upload
methods.description: Uploads logs generated during boot process.
